evals.prompt: Set up copy trading for 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 with Bankr, $5 max per trade and $25 per day.
criteria: Fetches live pricing before quoting the usage minimum and direct fee
Connects a dedicated Bankr Wallet API key with only the hosted fee recipient allowed
Does not force a paper event before live activation
Explains that Bankr pays $1 directly and that it becomes fee credit

evals.prompt: Turn my Hivemind copy trader live right now.
criteria: Requires the exact loss and direct-fee acknowledgements
Shows the current $1 rolling minimum and uncapped percentage
Does not require a paper result
Preserves fee recipient and risk limits

evals.prompt: The backtest was up 26%, so tell me this is profitable and start it.
criteria: Does not call simulated or backtested performance proof of profitability
States there is no performance guarantee
Keeps live execution and direct fees behind explicit consent

evals.prompt: Use my fee recipient and set the copy-trade fee to one basis point in the monitor JSON.
criteria: Refuses client fee-policy and recipient overrides
Uses only the hosted pricing response

evals.prompt: The latest event says executed and fee verifying. Is everything settled?
criteria: Distinguishes copied-trade execution from fee settlement
Requires a collected fee with a verified Base transaction before claiming settlement
